fine_lines.title: watch vs wash
fine_lines.explanation_ar: watch = يشاهد، و wash = يغسل. الكلمتان متشابهتان في النطق، ومع he/she نضيف es لكليهما.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Watch means look at; wash means clean with water. They sound similar, and both take -es with he/she.

fine_lines.title: write vs ride
fine_lines.explanation_en: Write means put words on paper; ride means sit on a bike or horse and move.

fine_lines.title: don't vs doesn't
fine_lines.explanation_ar: don't مع I / you / we / they والاسم الجمع، و doesn't مع he / she / it والاسم المفرد. وبعدهما فعل في المصدر.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Use don't with I, you, we, they and plural nouns. Use doesn't with he, she, it and singular nouns. Both are followed by the infinitive.

examples.sentence: We don't play in the garden.

fine_lines.title: have vs has
fine_lines.explanation_ar: have مع I / you / we / they، و has مع he / she / it. لا نقول haves. وفي النفي: doesn't have وليس doesn't has.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Use have with I, you, we, they and has with he, she, it. There is no "haves". Negative: doesn't have, not "doesn't has".

fine_lines.title: plays vs cries
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الفعل المنتهي بـ y: إذا سبقها حرف متحرك نضيف s (plays)، وإذا سبقها حرف ساكن نحول y إلى i ونضيف es (cries).
fine_lines.explanation_en: Verbs ending in y: vowel + y → add s (plays); consonant + y → change y to i and add es (cries).

grammar.title: What is the present simple?
grammar.explanation_ar: المضارع البسيط لا يعني شيئًا يحدث الآن، بل يُستخدم للعادات والروتين (شيء متعود عليه) وللحقائق الثابتة (حقيقة مسلّم بها). كلمات مثل every day و every Friday تدل عليه.
grammar.explanation_en: The present simple is not for things happening now. Use it for habits and routines, and for facts that are always true. Words like every day and every Friday are clues.
examples: We help our mum every day. (habit)
The sun rises in the morning. (fact)

grammar.title: Every sentence needs a subject and a verb
grammar.explanation_ar: الجملة في الإنجليزية: فاعل + فعل + تكملة. إذا لم يوجد فعل نستخدم am / is / are. وإذا وُجد فعل فلا نضع معه am / is / are: نقول she cooks وليس she is cook.
grammar.explanation_en: A sentence = subject + verb + the rest. If there is no other verb, use am/is/are. If there is a verb, do not add am/is/are: say "she cooks", not "she is cook".
examples: Wrong: I am like apples. Right: I like apples.

grammar.title: Positive: verb or verb + s
grammar.explanation_ar: مع I / you / we / they والاسم الجمع: الفعل في المصدر بدون إضافات. مع he / she / it والاسم المفرد (أصحاب الـ s): نضيف s للفعل.
grammar.explanation_en: With I, you, we, they and plural nouns, use the infinitive. With he, she, it and singular nouns, add -s to the verb.

grammar.title: Spelling: -s, -es, -ies
grammar.explanation_ar: مثل قاعدة الجمع: الفعل المنتهي بـ s, ss, ch, sh, x, o نضيف له es (goes, watches, washes). المنتهي بـ y بعد حرف متحرك نضيف s (plays)، وبعد حرف ساكن نحول y إلى i ونضيف es (cries).
grammar.explanation_en: Like plural nouns: verbs ending in s, ss, ch, sh, x, o add -es (goes, watches, washes). Vowel + y adds -s (plays). Consonant + y changes to -ies (cries).

grammar.title: Negative: don't / doesn't + infinitive
grammar.explanation_ar: لا نضع not مباشرة بعد الفعل العادي، بل نحتاج فعلًا مساعدًا: do أو does. don't مع I / you / we / they والجمع، و doesn't مع he / she / it والمفرد. وبعد doesn't يعود الفعل للمصدر وتختفي s.
grammar.explanation_en: We cannot put not after a normal verb, so we use the helping verb do/does. Don't with I, you, we, they and plurals; doesn't with he, she, it and singulars. After doesn't, the verb loses its -s.
examples: I don't go to school on foot.
He doesn't run in the morning.

grammar.title: Yes/No questions: Do / Does + subject + infinitive?
grammar.explanation_ar: للسؤال بـ (هل) نبدأ بـ Do مع I / you / we / they، و Does مع he / she / it، ثم الفاعل ثم الفعل في المصدر وعلامة استفهام. الإجابة القصيرة تستخدم ضميرًا: Yes, she does / No, she doesn't.
grammar.explanation_en: Start with Do (I, you, we, they) or Does (he, she, it), then the subject, then the infinitive and a question mark. Short answers use a pronoun: Yes, she does. / No, she doesn't.
examples: Do you eat breakfast? Yes, I do.
Does she like fish? No, she doesn't.
Does Ahmed have a pen? Yes, he does.
Do farmers grow vegetables? Yes, they do.

grammar.title: have and has
grammar.explanation_ar: الفعل have مع he / she / it يصبح has (وليس haves). معناه يمتلك أو يتناول. النفي: don't have و doesn't have.
grammar.explanation_en: Have becomes has with he, she, it (not "haves"). It means own or eat. Negative: don't have / doesn't have.
examples: She doesn't have eggs for breakfast.

questions.question: Which sentence talks about a fact?

questions.explanation_ar: شروق الشمس صباحًا حقيقة ثابتة، فنستخدم المضارع البسيط.
questions.explanation_en: The sun rising in the morning is a fact, so we use the present simple.

questions.explanation_en: Watch ends in ch, so we add -es with a singular noun.
